summary: This Form 6-K filed by Americas Gold & Silver Corp for June 2026 contains two exhibits: a news release announcing election of directors and annual meeting voting results, and a report of voting results. The filing discloses that eight nominees were elected as directors by a show of hands, and PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP was reappointed as auditors. The meeting held June 23, 2026 had 68.53% of shares represented. This is a routine annual meeting results filing, not a special situation.
